title: Uniform statewide regulation.
bodyText:
(a) This chapter shall apply uniformly throughout the State and to all political subdivisions of the State.

(b) This chapter shall supersede any ordinance or other regulation adopted by a political subdivision that specifically governs transportation network companies, transportation network company drivers, or transportation network company vehicles, including those adopted before January 1, 2023.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "January 1, 2023" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.

     (b)  This chapter shall supersede any ordinance or other regulation adopted by a political subdivision that specifically governs transportation network companies, transportation network company drivers, or transportation network company vehicles, including those adopted before January 1, 2023. [L 2022, c 57, pt of §2]

 

Revision Note
